title: Review
description: The reviewer's answer: for each condition, held by which cases or not held and why; its findings, each for the test writer or the builder; and one answer for each practice it was given.

conditions.description: One verdict for each item of the slice's definition of done.

findings.description: The findings, none when there is nothing to correct.

practices.description: One answer for each practice given, by id.

finding.description: One finding of the reviewer, for the test writer or for the builder.

to.description: Who the finding is for: the test writer corrects the tests, the builder the code.

case.description: A case's name, as the tests name it.

question.description: The question the case fails: Q1 to Q10 of reviewing-tests.md, negative-paths, condition, or the id of a practice given.

fix.description: One sentence on what would fix it. For the builder it shares no run of 20 characters with the tests.

condition.description: The reviewer's verdict on one condition: held by which cases, or not held and why.

items.description: A case's name, as the tests name it.

why.description: One sentence on why; it shares no run of 20 characters with the tests.

practice.description: The reviewer's answer on one practice: held, not held with the place, or does not apply.

id.description: The practice's id, such as P-12.

answer.description: Whether the round's tests and code hold the practice.

sentence.description: Why, in one sentence; for not-held, what is wrong at the path. About the builder's code it shares no run of 20 characters with the tests.

path.description: For not-held, the file that breaks the practice: one the builder changed, or a test.
